_doc: Joseph voice cast (docs/joseph/VOICE.md). Schema: tools/story/voice.py docstring.

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: the family storyteller (Qwen vivian), as in Esther, Ruth, Exodus, Prodigal, Daniel

joseph.design: 男性，声音清亮、温暖的青年男高音，听起来二十岁上下，诚实、明亮、善良，说话干净清楚。普通话标准。
joseph.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好、带着笑意，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
joseph.why: VoiceDesign clear warm tenor; one voice for 17 and 37: acting notes only

jacob.design: 男性，七十多岁的老爷爷，音调中低而平稳，嗓音沙哑、带气声，苍老但非常温暖慈爱，说话慢一些，始终是同一位老人的声音。普通话标准。
jacob.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好、带着笑意，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：

brother.design: 男性，三十岁左右，强壮结实的男中低音，嗓音低沉厚实，有力但不凶，带点冲劲，像一个爱闹脾气、嘴硬心软的大哥哥，听起来像动画片里的角色，让孩子不害怕。普通话标准。
brother.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好、带着笑意，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：

pharaoh.design: 男性，五十岁左右的胖国王，嗓音非常低沉，是浑厚洪亮的男低音，胸腔共鸣很强，圆润、有点夸张，自命不凡又有点憨，心地善良慷慨，像儿童动画片里滑稽可爱的大王。普通话标准。
pharaoh.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好、带着笑意，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：
pharaoh.why: VoiceDesign round pompous generous king; comic and kind, not Exodus' vain villain

narrator.instruct: A warm woman telling a Bible story to a child of four to ten at bedtime, like a mother at the bedside: loving, lively, natural, at a natural flowing pace. This line:
narrator.why: the same family storyteller in English (Qwen vivian; R7: no edge-tts)

joseph.design: Male, a clear, warm young tenor who sounds about twenty-five: honest, bright, kind, clean diction. Standard American English.
joseph.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. Warm, friendly, a smile in the voice, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:
joseph.why: VoiceDesign clear warm tenor, same person as zh in spirit

jacob.design: Male, around seventy-five, an elderly grandfather. Medium-low pitch, a little husky and breathy with the softness of old age; weathered but warm and loving. Standard American English.
jacob.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. Warm, friendly, a smile in the voice, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

brother.design: Male, around thirty, a strong, sturdy, deep baritone with a low, thick, chesty voice, powerful but never scary, with a bit of attitude, like a hot-tempered big brother with a soft heart in a children's cartoon. Standard American English.
brother.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. Warm, friendly, a smile in the voice, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

pharaoh.design: Male, around fifty, a big, round, jolly king with a very deep, booming bass voice and strong chest resonance: a little pompous but good-hearted and generous, funny and lovable like a king in a children's animated film. Standard American English.
pharaoh.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. Warm, friendly, a smile in the voice, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

js_01.m: 讲故事的开头，温暖亲切；说到“最疼的”时带着喜爱
js_01.m_en: storyteller opening, warm; fond on 最疼的 / 'loved most of all'

js_02.m: 慈爱的老父亲，嗓子略沙哑，因为送礼物很高兴；带一声开心的轻笑
js_02.m_en: an old, loving father, a little husky, delighted with his present; a happy chuckle

phrases.instruct: 老爷爷开心，带着一声轻轻的笑意。清楚地说出“约瑟”：“约”读第一声（yuē），高而平，“瑟”读 sè。

phrases.text: 爸爸给你做了一件新衣服，你看——五颜六色的！

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: A delighted old man with a soft chuckle in his voice.

phrases.text: Father has made you a new coat. Look... all the colours of the rainbow!

js_03.m: 十七岁，轻快明亮。十七岁的少年，惊喜万分，声音里带着笑
js_03.m_en: a bright boy of seventeen, lighter and quicker; a bright boy of seventeen, thrilled, a laugh in the voice

phrases.instruct: 十七岁少年惊喜得笑出声，声音又明亮又高兴。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: A boy thrilled, laughing with joy, bright.

js_04.m: 自言自语地嘟囔，嫉妒、酸溜溜；一声真正的“哼”
js_04.m_en: muttering to himself, jealous, sour; a real 哼

phrases.instruct: 嘟囔着，嫉妒又不高兴，真的哼了一声，不是念字。

phrases.text: 爸爸什么好东西都给他！

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: A real sour grunt through the nose, jealous, not reading the word.

phrases.text: Father gives him all the good things!

js_05.m: 十七岁，轻快明亮。急切、天真，完全没发现自己惹人烦；轻快明亮
js_05.m_en: a bright boy of seventeen, lighter and quicker; eager, innocent, no idea he is annoying anyone; quick and bright

js_06.m: 气坏了，声音越来越大、越来越重，不要变尖；“做梦”一把甩出来
js_06.m_en: outraged, voice getting louder and heavier, never shrill; snaps 做梦 / 'Dream on'

phrases.text: 什么？你是说，我们要向你下拜？

phrases.instruct: 气得大吼，声音低沉有力，狠狠地甩出这两个字。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.text: What? You mean WE are going to bow down to YOU?

phrases.instruct: Outraged, snapping it out, loud and deep.

js_07.m: 先有点好笑，说到“更生气了”时压低，带着担心
js_07.m_en: a little amused, then lower and worried on 更生气了 / 'angrier than ever'

js_08.m: 认真但温和，不吓人；放慢
js_08.m_en: serious but gentle, not frightening; slower

js_09.m: 十七岁，轻快明亮。从井里向上喊，害怕、哀求；短
js_09.m_en: a bright boy of seventeen, lighter and quicker; calling up from the well, frightened and pleading; short

js_10.m: 平淡，底下有点难过；“很远很远”拉长，越说越远
js_10.m_en: matter-of-fact, sad underneath; long and far on 很远很远 / 'far, far away'

phrases.text: 这时来了一队骆驼商人。
哥哥们收了二十块银子，就把约瑟卖了。
商人把他带去了很远很远的埃及。
phrases.instruct: 拉长“很远很远”，越说越远。

phrases.text: Just then some traders came by with their camels.
The brothers took twenty pieces of silver and sold Joseph.
The traders took him far, far away, to Egypt.
phrases.instruct: Long and distant on 'far, far away'.

js_11.m: 老人轻轻的哭声；哽咽，很轻，不是嚎啕
js_11.m_en: an old man's quiet weeping; broken, very soft; not wailing

phrases.instruct: 老人轻轻地、哽咽地说，带着低低的抽泣，很轻，不是嚎啕。清楚地说出“约瑟”：“约”读第一声（yuē），高而平，“瑟”读 sè。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: An old man, quiet and choked with soft sobbing breaths, very soft, not wailing.

js_12.m: 平稳；说“又认真又诚实”时为他骄傲；说“关进了监牢”时叹口气
js_12.m_en: steady; proud of him on 又认真又诚实; a sigh on 关进了监牢 / 'put in prison'

phrases.text: In Egypt, Joseph became a servant.
He worked hard and he was honest.
But someone told a lie about him,
and he was put in prison.

js_13.m: 三十七岁，沉稳偏低。安静，已是个年长一些的青年；难过但信靠，不自怜；声音比从前低、稳
js_13.m_en: now a calm governor of thirty-seven, lower and steadier; quiet, a little older now; sad but trusting; no self-pity

js_14.m: 温暖笃定，像把手搭在肩上
js_14.m_en: warm and sure, like a hand on the shoulder

js_15.m: 神秘又好笑的睡前故事声音；“肥肥的”圆，“瘦瘦的”细；说“吃掉了”时倒抽一口气
js_15.m_en: spooky-funny bedtime voice; round on 肥肥的 / 'fat', thin on 瘦瘦的 / 'skinny'; a gasp on 吃掉了

phrases.text: 一天夜里，埃及的国王法老做了个怪梦：
phrases.instruct: 神秘又好笑的睡前故事声音。

phrases.text: 七头肥肥的牛从河里上来，

phrases.instruct: 倒抽一口气，夸张地惊讶。

phrases.text: One night Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, had a strange dream.
Seven fat cows came up out of the river.
and they ate the fat cows right up!

js_16.m: 用低沉浑厚的男低音：一位大国王慌了神，滑稽；大嗓门，慌乱但嗓音始终低沉；最后一句霸道
js_16.m_en: in a deep booming bass, relaxed and genial even when startled: a big jolly king puzzled by a funny dream; bossy and kind on the last sentence

phrases.instruct: 一位低沉浑厚的大国王做噩梦惊醒，吼了一声，夸张，嗓音始终低沉，不要尖。
慌乱、急急地说，嗓音依然是低沉的男低音。

phrases.text: 这是什么意思？谁能告诉我！
phrases.instruct: 着急又霸道，命令的口气，低沉有力。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: A big deep-voiced king waking from a silly dream with a booming 'Aah!', comic, low and round.

phrases.text: Cows eating cows? Grain eating grain?
phrases.instruct: Puzzled and bumbling, deep and round, not high.

phrases.text: What does it mean? Somebody tell me!
phrases.instruct: Bossy but kind, deep and booming.

js_17.m: 用低沉的男低音：满怀希望，身体前倾；一位好几夜没睡的国王
js_17.m_en: in a deep bass: hopeful, leaning forward; a king who has not slept

js_18.m: 三十七岁，沉稳偏低。谦卑而平静；说“上帝会”时清楚笃定；声音沉稳、偏低
js_18.m_en: now a calm governor of thirty-seven, lower and steadier; humble and calm; clear and sure on 上帝会 / 'God can'

js_19.m: 三十七岁，沉稳偏低。清楚，像温和的老师扳着手指数；结尾急切又热心；沉稳
js_19.m_en: now a calm governor of thirty-seven, lower and steadier; clear, like a kind teacher counting on his fingers; urgent and helpful at the end

phrases.text: 七头肥牛，是七个大丰收的年头。
七头瘦牛，是七个闹饥荒的年头。
请您趁丰收的时候，把粮食存起来！
The seven fat cows are seven years with plenty of food.
The seven skinny cows are seven years with no food at all.
So store up grain in the good years, while you can!
phrases.instruct: Sincere and urgent, wanting to help.

js_20.m: 用低沉浑厚的男低音：高兴极了，洪亮，慷慨，像大笑着说话；最后一句张开双臂
js_20.m_en: in a deep booming bass: warm and delighted, a big generous laugh in the voice but staying low and round; arms wide on the last sentence

js_21.m: 忙碌明亮；“满满的”说得大大的
js_21.m_en: busy and bright; big on 满满的 / 'heaps and heaps'

js_22.m: 干巴巴，很累；说“只有埃及有粮食”时抬起一点希望
js_22.m_en: dry and tired, then a lift of hope on 只有埃及有粮食 / 'except in Egypt'

phrases.text: 后来，饥荒真的来了，到处都没有饭吃。
雅各就叫儿子们去埃及买粮。
Then the hungry years really came. There was no food anywhere...
So Jacob sent his sons to Egypt to buy grain.

js_23.m: 谦卑、疲惫，一点傲气都没有了；低着头
js_23.m_en: humble, tired, nothing left of the old sneer; head down

js_24.m: 压低声音，像和孩子分享一个秘密；说“那个梦”时带着惊叹
js_24.m_en: hushed, a secret shared with the child; wonder on 那个梦 / 'the dream'

js_25.m: 三十七岁，沉稳偏低。想装成陌生人，可声音在发抖；很轻
js_25.m_en: now a calm governor of thirty-seven, lower and steadier; trying to sound like a stranger, but the voice shakes; very soft

js_26.m: 三十七岁，沉稳偏低。泪水和喜悦同时涌出，名字脱口而出
js_26.m_en: now a calm governor of thirty-seven, lower and steadier; the dam breaks: tears and joy at once; the name bursts out

phrases.instruct: 名字冲口而出，又高兴又流泪。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: The name bursts out, joyful and in tears.

js_27.m: 发抖，羞愧，快哭了；道歉是真心的
js_27.m_en: shaking, ashamed, close to tears; the apology is real

phrases.text: 我们对你做了那么坏的事……

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.text: We did such a terrible thing to you...

js_28.m: 三十七岁，沉稳偏低。整个故事的中心：温柔，完全原谅，沉稳；说“把坏事变成了好事”时放慢
js_28.m_en: now a calm governor of thirty-seven, lower and steadier; the heart of the story: gentle, completely forgiving, steady; slow on 把坏事变成了好事

phrases.text: 可是上帝把坏事变成了好事，
phrases.instruct: 这是整个故事的中心，慢，稳，说“坏事变成了好事”时放慢。

phrases.text: Don't be afraid, and don't be sad.
but God turned it into something good,
phrases.instruct: The heart of the story: slow and steady.

js_29.m_en: glad, a little out of breath with happiness

js_30.m: 又哭又笑，老人声音里全是光；嗓音仍然低低沙哑，不要尖
js_30.m_en: happy tears, laughing and crying together; an old voice full of light, still low and husky, never shrill

phrases.instruct: 又哭又笑，一位老人欣喜若狂。清楚地说出“约瑟”：“约”读第一声（yuē），高而平，“瑟”读 sè。
含着泪笑，声音里全是光。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|呜

phrases.instruct: Laughing and crying together, an old man overjoyed.
Laughing through tears, full of light.

js_31.m: 温暖的结尾，直接对孩子说话；数三个地方
js_31.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; count the three places gently; smile on the last sentence

phrases.text: 在井里，在监牢里，在王宫里，
phrases.instruct: 一个地方一个地方地数，像数手指。

phrases.text: 上帝一直和约瑟在一起。
遇到难过的事，你也不是一个人——
phrases.instruct: 直接对孩子说话，轻轻的。

phrases.text: 上帝能把坏事变成好事。
In the well, in the prison, in the palace,
God was with Joseph all the way.
When sad things happen to you, you are not alone either.
phrases.instruct: Speaking right to the child, softly.

phrases.text: God can turn bad things into good.
phrases.instruct: Sure and warm, like a promise.
